segments.name: ZERUST® products and services
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and markets rust and corrosion inhibiting products and services for automotive, industrial, mining, agricultural, retail and oil and gas markets.
segments.evidence: ZERUST® Corrosion Prevention Solutions . In fiscal 2025, 74.2% of NTIC's consolidated net sales were derived from developing, manufacturing and marketing ZERUST® rust and corrosion inhibiting products and services.

segments.name: Natur-Tec® products
segments.description: Markets bio-based and certified compostable polymer resin compounds and finished products to replace conventional petroleum-based plastics.
segments.evidence: Additionally, NTIC markets and sells a portfolio of proprietary bio-based and certified compostable (fully biodegradable) polymer resin compounds and finished products under the Natur-Tec® brand.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay NTIC for ZERUST® and Natur-Tec® products sold directly, through subsidiaries, or via distributors, with revenue recognized primarily upon shipment.
revenueModel.evidence: NTIC recognizes revenue from the sale of its products primarily upon shipment of the products.
